story.titleZh: FIA官方批准2027年世界拉力-越野赛历变更
story.summaryZh: FIA世界汽车运动理事会正式批准了2027年FIA世界拉力-越野赛历的变更，确认葡萄牙和摩洛哥将举办标志性的达喀尔拉力赛。

story.originalTitle: 🗓️ Mark your calendars! 🗓️ The FIA World Motor Sport Council has officially approved changes to the 2027 FIA World Rally-Raid Championship cal...
story.summaryEn:
🗓️ Mark your calendars! 🗓️
The FIA World Motor Sport Council has officially approved changes to the 2027 FIA World Rally-Raid Championship calendar, confirming that Portugal and Morocco will host the iconic Dakar Rally from 9–23 January 2027.
#FIA #Dakar2027 #RallyRaid
detailZh:
🗓️ 记得在日历上标记！🗓️
国际汽车联合会世界汽车运动理事会正式批准了对2027年FIA世界拉力-越野赛历的修改，确认葡萄牙和摩洛哥将举办标志性的达喀尔拉力赛，时间为2027年1月9日至23日。
#FIA #Dakar2027 #RallyRaid
detailEn:
🗓️ Mark your calendars! 🗓️
The FIA World Motor Sport Council has officially approved changes to the 2027 FIA World Rally-Raid Championship calendar, confirming that Portugal and Morocco will host the iconic Dakar Rally from 9–23 January 2027.
